description:
Discharge of conditions for approved permission 2651/22: Car Parking (condition 3); Soft landscaping - existing and proposed (condition 4); Cycle Parking (condition 5); Refuse storage and recycling facilities (prior to occupation) (condition 6); Management Plan (condition 7); Communal amenity space (condition 8); Fire Safety (condition 9) (summary)

3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
decision_conditions: The details submitted with the application are insufficient as the proposal does not fully address the requirements of the condition as the proposal does not provide seven secure and sheltered cycle spaces within the front forecourt of the site. The submitted details cannot be considered to satisfy the requirements of  Policy T5 of the London Plan, and Policy LP23 of the Council's Local Plan.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
